title: Analyst, Risk Management
jobDescription:
<div class="content-intro"><p>Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision
- to simplify payments for Indian businesses
- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.</p> <p>Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.</p> <p>From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners
- including banks, networks, regulators
- we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech</p> <p>Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation
- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.</p> <p>Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.</p> <p>Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, Whats App, Airtel, CRED, Bookmy Show, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme
- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.</p> <p>We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India &amp; SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, Master Card, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions
- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), Bill Me (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI)
- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.</p> <p>But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen
- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle
- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People &gt; Pedigree
- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles
- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy &amp; Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,&nbsp; you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.</p></div><div> <h2>

ROLE:
Analyst – Risk Management</h2> <h3>Job Summary</h3> <p>This is a permanent role that requires strong knowledge and experience in the merchant acquiring side of the payments business. The role focuses on merchant onboarding, KYC due diligence, website assessment, transaction monitoring, fraud detection, and ongoing merchant risk monitoring. The candidate will be responsible for identifying suspicious activities through data analysis and recommending appropriate risk mitigation measures.</p> <h3>Roles and Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Perform merchant due diligence, KYC validation, website assessment, and merchant onboarding reviews.</li> <li>Monitor merchant transactions, identify abnormal patterns, and detect potential fraud or policy violations.</li> <li>Conduct detailed investigations into suspicious merchant activities and recommend appropriate risk actions.</li> <li>Perform merchant monitoring using transaction trends, behavioural analysis, and risk indicators.</li> <li>Analyze transaction data using Excel and prepare review reports.</li> <li>Handle merchant escalations and exception cases from business and operations teams.</li> <li>Maintain clear communication with merchants through emails and calls.</li> <li>Have a good understanding of merchant onboarding processes and payment risk controls.</li> <li>Knowledge of chargebacks, card scheme guidelines, and fraud monitoring will be an added advantage.</li> </ul> <h3>Qualifications &amp; Experience</h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor's Degree.</li> <li>Relevant experience in Merchant Risk, Transaction Monitoring, Fraud Risk, Merchant Acquiring, or Payment Operations.</li> <li>Hands-on experience in merchant monitoring and fraud identification.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills with experience in transaction data analysis.</li> <li>Proficiency in Microsoft Excel.</li> <li>Knowledge of chargebacks, Visa/Mastercard guidelines, and fraud-related reason codes is preferred.</li> </ul> <h3>Core Skills</h3> <ul> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.</li> <li>Excellent verbal and written communication skills.</li> <li>High attention to detail and accuracy.</li> <li>Ability to identify suspicious transaction patterns and anomalies.</li> <li>Good stakeholder management and interpersonal skills.</li> <li>Proficiency in&nbsp;<strong>Hindi and English</strong>&nbsp;is preferred.</li> </ul> <h3>Additional Requirements</h3> <ul> <li>Willingness to work in rotational shifts.</li> <li>Willingness to provide support on weekends and public holidays, based on business requirements.</li> <li>Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while meeting defined SLAs and TATs.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Location:</strong>&nbsp;Bangalore</p> </div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div>&nbsp;</div><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="gmail_default"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; <div class="content-intro"><p>Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision
- to simplify payments for Indian businesses
- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.</p> <p>Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.</p> <p>From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners
- including banks, networks, regulators
- we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech</p> <p>Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation
- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.</p> <p>Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.</p> <p>Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, Whats App, Airtel, CRED, Bookmy Show, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme
- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.</p> <p>We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India &amp; SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, Master Card, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions
- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), Bill Me (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI)
- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.</p> <p>But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen
- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle
- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People &gt; Pedigree
- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles
- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy &amp; Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,&nbsp; you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.</p></div><div class="relative title: Engineering Manager
jobDescription:
<div class="content-intro"><p>Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision
- to simplify payments for Indian businesses
- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.</p> <p>Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.</p> <p>From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners
- including banks, networks, regulators
- we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech</p> <p>Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation
- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.</p> <p>Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.</p> <p>Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, Whats App, Airtel, CRED, Bookmy Show, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme
- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.</p> <p>We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India &amp; SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, Master Card, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions
- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), Bill Me (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI)
- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.</p> <p>But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen
- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle
- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People &gt; Pedigree
- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles
- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy &amp; Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,&nbsp; you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.</p></div><p><strong>Title:&nbsp;</strong><strong>Engineering Manager</strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p><strong>The

ROLE:
</strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>The Engineering Manager at Razorpay comes with considerable engineering management experience and proven leadership skills. You are expected to work on multiple projects at the same time, and also build and manage teams of engineers, possibly with a diverse set of tech skills. You may also be required to manage first-line managers. You will formulate and execute strategies, and coordinate with other managers. Your responsibilities mainly include people management, delivery management, and overseeing all the activities related to each project.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Roles and

RESPONSIBILITIES:
</strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>We believe in Impact creation at scale, so it is imperative for a Engineering Manager.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to attract and hire top-notch Engineering talent for the organization.&nbsp;</li> <li>Be responsible for the group's technical strategy and roadmap
- creating success metrics in close collaboration with other groups across the organization in executing initiatives in an agile way.&nbsp;</li> <li>Brings a strong perspective that drives change and motivates engineers to develop simple solutions to complex problems.&nbsp;</li> <li>Help implement effective engineering processes and champion their adoption.&nbsp;</li> <li>Has the technical capacity and capability to partner with tech leads and architects in problem-solving.&nbsp;</li> <li>Mentor the professional development of each direct report through personal and performance management.&nbsp;</li> <li>Give engineers the tools, confidence, and motivation to make decisions independently that lead to their recognition.&nbsp;</li> <li>Effective at influencing a culture of engineering craftsmanship and excellence.&nbsp;</li> <li>Initiate cross-functional (Product, Business, Operations) collaborations with development teams throughout Razorpay and gather feedback and requirements. Seek diverse perspectives to drive bottom-up innovation and create buy-in from all technical stakeholders.&nbsp;</li> <li>Ensure the team fully understands the goals and objectives of Razorpay as a company and how their work fits into 'the bigger picture.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Mandatory

QUALIFICATIONS:
</strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></p> <ul> <li>Total of 10+ years experience, 6+ years of experience in very large-scale applications, and 3+ years experience in actual people management.&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong problem-solving skills, data structures, and algorithms.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience with distributed systems handling large amounts of data.&nbsp;</li> <li>Excellent coding skills in one of the languages PHP/Python/C++/Java.&nbsp;</li> <li>Very good understanding of Web Technologies.&nbsp;</li> <li>Very good understanding of any RDBMS and/or messaging.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Location: Bangalore&nbsp;</strong></p><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="gmail_default"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; title: Group Manager, Sales Enablement
jobDescription:
<div class="content-intro"><p>Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision
- to simplify payments for Indian businesses
- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.</p> <p>Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.</p> <p>From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners
- including banks, networks, regulators
- we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech</p> <p>Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation
- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.</p> <p>Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.</p> <p>Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, Whats App, Airtel, CRED, Bookmy Show, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme
- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.</p> <p>We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India &amp; SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, Master Card, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions
- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), Bill Me (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI)
- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.</p> <p>But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen
- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle
- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People &gt; Pedigree
- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles
- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy &amp; Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,&nbsp; you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.</p></div><h3><strong>Role Summary</strong></h3> <p>Lead the Partnerships function for Razorpay POS by building and scaling the System Integrator (SI), Referral, and Strategic Partner ecosystem to drive merchant acquisition, payment volumes, and value-added services. Own partner strategy, commercial governance, GTM execution, and cross-functional program management while acting as the primary interface between business, product, engineering, finance, legal, banking partners, and external stakeholders.</p> <h3><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></h3> <p><strong>Partnership Strategy &amp; Growth</strong></p> <ul> <li>Define and execute the partner strategy for System Integrators, Referral Partners, OEMs, Banks, and Enterprise ecosystem partners.</li> <li>Build scalable partnership programs that drive merchant acquisition, POS deployments, and revenue growth.</li> <li>Identify and onboard strategic partners aligned with Razorpay's long-term business objectives.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Commercials &amp; Partner Governance</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead commercial negotiations, pricing frameworks, revenue-sharing models, and partnership agreements.</li> <li>Establish governance mechanisms to ensure commercial viability, financial controls, and scalable partner operations.</li> <li>Drive commercial approvals in collaboration with Finance and Leadership while maintaining standardized contracting processes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Go-to-Market (GTM) &amp; Business Enablement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and execute joint GTM initiatives with partners to accelerate enterprise and mid-market merchant acquisition.</li> <li>Collaborate with Sales, Enterprise, and Banking teams to create scalable partner-led acquisition channels.</li> <li>Enable partner-led cross-selling of payment solutions and value-added services.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Program Management &amp; Cross-functional Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive end-to-end execution of strategic partnership initiatives by collaborating with Product, Engineering, Operations, Finance, Legal, Risk, and Banking teams.</li> <li>Own partner escalations, program governance, and executive stakeholder communication.</li> <li>Ensure timely delivery of strategic initiatives while balancing business priorities and operational efficiency.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Partner Success &amp; Ecosystem Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build long-term strategic relationships with key partner leadership teams.</li> <li>Drive partner enablement through onboarding, training, solution adoption, and business reviews.</li> <li>Monitor partner performance through defined KPIs and implement growth plans to maximize business outcomes.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Business Planning &amp; Executive Reporting</strong></p> <ul> <li>Track and report partnership performance across merchant acquisition, integrated TIDs, revenue contribution, and strategic initiatives.</li> <li>Present business updates, growth opportunities, risks, and recommendations to senior leadership.</li> <li>Develop scalable operating frameworks to improve partner productivity and organizational efficiency.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Key Outcomes</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Scale the SI and Referral Partner ecosystem&nbsp;</li> <li>Enable Referral and Integrator-led deployments&nbsp;</li> <li>Establish partnerships as a strategic acquisition channel for enterprise merchants and POS growth.</li> <li>Built governance frameworks for partner onboarding, commercial approvals, and standardized agreements.</li> <li>Lead strategic negotiations with software partners, banks, and enterprise ecosystem players to unlock new revenue opportunities while mitigating commercial and operational risk.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Core Competencies</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Strategic Partnerships</li> <li>Partner Ecosystem Development</li> <li>GTM Strategy &amp; Execution</li> <li>Enterprise Business Development</li> <li>Commercial Negotiations</li> <li>Program &amp; Portfolio Management</li> <li>Cross-functional Leadership</li> <li>Banking &amp; Fintech Partnerships</li> <li>Revenue Growth &amp; Business Strategy</li> <li>Executive Communication</li> <li>Process Design &amp; Governance</li> <li>Payment Integration Understanding</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="gmail_default"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span id="m_2989597180337834284gmail-m_4972969247898306296gmail-docs-internal-guid-3a65a3c2-7fff-88ff-9e94-8ab11a050d04">Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe. </span><br></span></div> <div class="gmail_default"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; experienceProfile.rawText: <div class="content-intro"><p>Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.</p> <p>Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.</p> <p>From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech</p> <p>Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.</p> <p>Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.</p> <p>Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, Whats App, Airtel, CRED, Bookmy Show, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.</p> <p>We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India &amp; SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, Master Card, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. jobDescription:
<div class="content-intro"><p>Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision
- to simplify payments for Indian businesses
- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.</p> <p>Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.</p> <p>From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners
- including banks, networks, regulators
- we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech</p> <p>Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation
- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.</p> <p>Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.</p> <p>Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, Whats App, Airtel, CRED, Bookmy Show, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme
- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.</p> <p>We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India &amp; SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, Master Card, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions
- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), Bill Me (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI)
- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.</p> <p>But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen
- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle
- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People &gt; Pedigree
- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles
- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy &amp; Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,&nbsp; you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.</p></div><p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Roles and

RESPONSIBILITIES:
</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Growing the overall portfolio and driving cross-sell/up-sell of Trust Scan offerings across the New and existing Razorpay merchant base.&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Working in close collaboration with Enterprise, Mid market &amp; SME teams to enable Trust Scan on their existing and new merchant portfolio</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Work in tandem with the product team to identify suitable product solutions needed for our partners while leveraging our internal capabilities.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Build Trust Scan business strategy along with GTM strategy.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Defining and analyzing performance metrics, and achieving cross-functional alignment.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Involvement in strategic discussions in terms of identifying new areas of opportunity</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Coming up with strategies to increase penetration of Trust Scan offerings along with sales funnel management</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Gathering inputs from business teams &amp; merchants to further enhance and develop the Trust Scan pipeline</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Collaborate across multiple Internal units – Product, Sales &amp; Analytics to deliver optimum output</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Support the business with data-driven actionable insights that help business to take informed decisions to improve the sales processes and drive efficiency</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>Mandatory

QUALIFICATIONS:
</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">4+ years of proven experience in product/tech-based organization with B2B/Banking focus &amp; understanding of Data Science &amp; Analytics will be an added advantage.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Experience in a high-paced and unstructured environment will be a plus. Ability to solve various unstructured business problems in an objective way will be one of the key criteria for hiring.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Technical aptitude and ability to learn tech software.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Strong interpersonal skills and an ability to build rapport with customers and cross-functional teams internally.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Strong hunting skills are desired with a fair bit of understanding of digital payments ecosystem.&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Proactive Identification of opportunity areas for enterprise customers and focused selling is a must. Understanding &amp; awareness of Data landscape is a plus.&nbsp;</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Good in taking initiatives and implementation of the same</span></li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="gmail_default"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span id="m_2989597180337834284gmail-m_4972969247898306296gmail-docs-internal-guid-3a65a3c2-7fff-88ff-9e94-8ab11a050d04">Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe. </span><br></span></div> <div class="gmail_default"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">&nbsp;</span></div> <div class="gmail_default"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span id="m_2989597180337834284gmail-m_4972969247898306296gmail-docs-internal-guid-3d0a9248-7fff-a2fd-6fa3-5026f85768d7">Follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/razorpay/mycompany/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.linkedin.com/company/razorpay/mycompany/&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1660290870959000&amp;usg=AOv Vaw0f6s Crv8Ce3IHBv N2Sev8Z">Linked In</a> &amp; <a href="https://twitter.com/Razorpay" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://twitter.com/Razorpay&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1660290870959000&amp;usg=AOv Vaw0Viu P9uut Fg1q FCm2n Heh1">Twitter</a></span></span></div></div>

title: Manager, Enterprise Partnerships
jobDescription:
<div class="content-intro"><p>Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision
- to simplify payments for Indian businesses
- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.</p> <p>Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.</p> <p>From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners
- including banks, networks, regulators
- we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech</p> <p>Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation
- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.</p> <p>Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.</p> <p>Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, Whats App, Airtel, CRED, Bookmy Show, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme
- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.</p> <p>We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India &amp; SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, Master Card, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions
- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), Bill Me (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI)
- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.</p> <p>But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen
- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle
- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People &gt; Pedigree
- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles
- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy &amp; Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,&nbsp; you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.</p></div><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>The

ROLE:
</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">We are looking for a dynamic and strategic partnerships professional to drive global large enterprise merchant partnerships for our international banking loyalty programs. This role will be responsible for identifying and onboarding high-value merchants across India, APAC, and CEMEA markets, crafting impactful program constructs, leading commercial negotiations, and ensuring seamless merchant integration and management.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
</strong></span></p> <ol> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Merchant Acquisition &amp; Program Design</span></li> </ol> <ul> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Identify and onboard top-tier global and regional merchants across retail, travel, hospitality, dining, and lifestyle sectors.</span></li> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Develop and structure customized loyalty program constructs that align with banking partners' goals and consumer behavior.</span></li> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Assess market trends and customer insights to optimize merchant offers and benefits within the loyalty program.</span></li> </ul> <ol> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Commercial Negotiation &amp; Onboarding</span></li> </ol> <ul> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Lead end-to-end commercial discussions, negotiations, and contract closures with merchants.</span></li> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Define revenue models, incentive structures, and merchant discount frameworks to ensure program profitability.</span></li> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Oversee merchant onboarding and integration, working closely with internal product and tech teams for seamless execution.</span></li> </ul> <ol> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Merchant Relationship Management</span></li> </ol> <ul> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Work closely with internal teams, including banking partnerships, product, marketing, and operations, to ensure smooth execution of programs.</span></li> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What We’re Looking For:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">5+ years of experience in merchant partnerships, business development, or strategic alliances in banking, fintech, or loyalty program domains.</span></li> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Strong understanding of banking loyalty programs, card-linked offers, and merchant-funded benefits.</span></li> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Expertise in commercial negotiations and structuring high-impact partnerships with large enterprises.</span></li> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Experience working across India, APAC, and CEMEA markets, with deep knowledge of regional merchant ecosystems.</span></li> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Ability to work in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment with a strategic and execution-focused mindset.</span></li> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Strong analytical skills with the ability to derive data-driven insights and optimize partnership performance.</span></li> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; title: Senior Analyst, Business Operations
jobDescription:
<div class="content-intro"><p>Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision
- to simplify payments for Indian businesses
- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.</p> <p>Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.</p> <p>From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners
- including banks, networks, regulators
- we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech</p> <p>Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation
- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.</p> <p>Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.</p> <p>Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, Whats App, Airtel, CRED, Bookmy Show, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme
- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.</p> <p>We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India &amp; SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, Master Card, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions
- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), Bill Me (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI)
- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.</p> <p>But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen
- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle
- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People &gt; Pedigree
- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles
- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy &amp; Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,&nbsp; you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.</p></div><p><strong>The

ROLE:
</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented Associate, Customer Success Partner to support day-to-day merchant operations and deliver outstanding customer experience. The ideal candidate will assist in resolving merchant queries, ensuring smooth transaction flows, and coordinating with cross-functional teams for timely issue resolution. A basic understanding of payment methods and reconciliation processes will be an added advantage. This role is a great opportunity for someone who is eager to learn and grow in the fintech/customer success space.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ol> <li>End-to-End Ownership of Merchant Issues:</li> <ul> <li>Handle complex or high-value merchant concerns, ensuring timely and satisfactory resolution with minimal follow-ups.</li> </ul> <li>Escalation Management:</li> <ul> <li>Take ownership of L2/L3 escalations, coordinate with cross-functional teams (Product, Risk, Tech, Fin Ops), and ensure root cause identification and resolution.</li> </ul> <li>Workflow Optimization &amp; SOP Design:</li> <ul> <li>Identify gaps in current processes and contribute to the creation or improvement of SOPs to enhance resolution efficiency and merchant experience.</li> </ul> <li>Merchant Communication &amp; Stakeholder Alignment:</li> <ul> <li>Maintain clear and professional communication with merchants and internal stakeholders to keep all parties informed on resolution progress.</li> </ul> <li>Operational Reporting &amp; Metrics Tracking:</li> <ul> <li>Track SLAs, TATs, and resolution quality metrics; generate reports for leadership to monitor performance and identify bottlenecks.</li> </ul> <li>Mentorship &amp; Peer Support:</li> <ul> <li>Guide and mentor junior associates, conduct case reviews, and ensure adherence to quality and tone standards.</li> </ul> <li>Special Projects &amp; Initiatives:</li> <ul> <li>Lead or contribute to strategic projects such as refund pattern analysis, feature enablement audits, or new payment flow adoption.</li> </ul> <li>Product Feedback Loop:</li> <ul> <li>Identify and relay recurring merchant feedback or product issues to the product/tech teams for prioritization.</li> </ul> <li>Audit Readiness &amp; Compliance:</li> <ul> <li>Ensure all customer interactions, tickets, and resolutions are properly documented to support internal or regulatory audits.</li> </ul> </ol> <p><br><br><strong>Required Skills &amp; Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>

EDUCATION:
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, or a related field.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience : Minimum 2–3 years of experience in customer service, operations, or a similar domain.</li> <li>Knowledge of Payment Ecosystem : Familiarity with UPI, Net Banking, Card Payments, e NACH, settlement processes, and refund mechanisms.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="gmail_default"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span id="m_2989597180337834284gmail-m_4972969247898306296gmail-docs-internal-guid-3a65a3c2-7fff-88ff-9e94-8ab11a050d04">Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe. </span><br></span></div> <div class="gmail_default"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">&nbsp;</span></div> <div class="gmail_default"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span id="m_2989597180337834284gmail-m_4972969247898306296gmail-docs-internal-guid-3d0a9248-7fff-a2fd-6fa3-5026f85768d7">Follow us on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/razorpay/mycompany/" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://www.linkedin.com/company/razorpay/mycompany/&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1660290870959000&amp;usg=AOv Vaw0f6s Crv8Ce3IHBv N2Sev8Z">Linked In</a> &amp; <a href="https://twitter.com/Razorpay" target="_blank" data-saferedirecturl="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://twitter.com/Razorpay&amp;source=gmail&amp;ust=1660290870959000&amp;usg=AOv Vaw0Viu P9uut Fg1q FCm2n Heh1">Twitter</a></span></span></div></div>

title: Senior Associate, Cross Border (KAM)
jobDescription:
<div class="content-intro"><p>Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision
- to simplify payments for Indian businesses
- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.</p> <p>Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.</p> <p>From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners
- including banks, networks, regulators
- we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech</p> <p>Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation
- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.</p> <p>Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.</p> <p>Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, Whats App, Airtel, CRED, Bookmy Show, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme
- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.</p> <p>We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India &amp; SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, Master Card, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions
- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), Bill Me (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI)
- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.</p> <p>But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen
- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle
- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People &gt; Pedigree
- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles
- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy &amp; Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,&nbsp; you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>As part of Razorpay Money Saver's Account Management team, you will own a portfolio of merchants, driving retention, customer success, and business growth. You will build trusted relationships with startups, enterprises, and SMBs, proactively solving business challenges while identifying opportunities for cross-sell, upsell, and referrals. This is a high-ownership role where success is measured by customer outcomes, portfolio growth, and long-term partnerships.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Roles and Responsibilities&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Manage and grow a portfolio of merchant accounts, serving as the primary relationship owner throughout the customer lifecycle.&nbsp;</p> <p>Build trusted relationships, drive retention, resolve escalations, and identify opportunities for revenue &amp; volume growth.&nbsp;</p> <p>Become a product expert and advise merchants on the best Money Saver solutions for their business needs.&nbsp;</p> <p>Drive customer success by improving product adoption, customer satisfaction and long-term account health.&nbsp;</p> <p>Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver a seamless customer experience and improve operational efficiency.&nbsp;</p> <p>Generate portfolio growth through cross-selling, upselling, and customer referrals.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>What We Are Looking For&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>3 to 5 years of experience in Sales, Account Management, Customer Success, or a similar client-facing role in fintech, Saa S, or payments.&nbsp;</p> <p>Track record of driving customer retention, expansion, and revenue growth. • Experience managing relationships with senior business stakeholders and decision-makers.&nbsp;</p> <p>Business acumen to understand customer needs and recommend the right solutions. • Analytical mindset with experience using CRM tools and customer insights to make decisions.&nbsp;</p> <p>Willingness to travel and meet customers to build long-term partnerships. • Eagerness to leverage AI to optimize workflows, drive merchant success, and utilize data-driven insights.&nbsp;</p> <p>Self-driven, organized, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-growth environment with a high sense of ownership.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Nice to Have&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Experience working in a fintech or payments company.&nbsp;</p> <p>Familiarity with SQL, dashboards, or BI tools to pull and analyze customer data. • MBA or background in finance, economics, or business.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>Bengaluru, India.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="gmail_default"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; jobDescription:
<div class="content-intro"><p>Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision
- to simplify payments for Indian businesses
- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.</p> <p>Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.</p> <p>From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners
- including banks, networks, regulators
- we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech</p> <p>Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation
- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.</p> <p>Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.</p> <p>Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, Whats App, Airtel, CRED, Bookmy Show, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme
- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.</p> <p>We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India &amp; SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, Master Card, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions
- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), Bill Me (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI)
- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.</p> <p>But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen
- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle
- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People &gt; Pedigree
- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles
- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy &amp; Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,&nbsp; you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.</p></div><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">The

title: Senior Product Manager
jobDescription:
<div class="content-intro"><p>Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision
- to simplify payments for Indian businesses
- we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.</p> <p>Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.</p> <p>From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners
- including banks, networks, regulators
- we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech</p> <p>Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation
- powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.</p> <p>Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.</p> <p>Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, Whats App, Airtel, CRED, Bookmy Show, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme
- and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.</p> <p>We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India &amp; SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, Master Card, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions
- including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), Bill Me (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI)
- along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.</p> <p>But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen
- you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle
- if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People &gt; Pedigree
- we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles
- this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy &amp; Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,&nbsp; you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.</p></div><h1><span style="font-size: 12pt; font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;"><strong>The

ROLE:

</strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">As a Growth PM at Razorpay, you will play a pivotal role in driving the adoption, activation, retention, and monetization of our products. Prompt engineering is table stakes.</span></li> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Entrepreneur DNA — you've tried building something of your own (a startup, a side project, a 0→1 product) or you're a seasoned Growth PM who's operated across the full acquisition-to-revenue loop.</span></li> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Business-grade judgment — you hold your own in revenue conversations, understand unit economics, and translate growth levers into P&amp;L impact.</span></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>This is not a feature PM role.</strong> There's no stable roadmap someone hands you. You define problems, find levers, ship fast, and measure what matters.</span></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What you'll do -&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Build Customer Empathy: PMs have to regularly meet and understand customer needs first-hand as well as stay on top of the customer pulse via secondary insights

Ensures value-based prioritization of product initiatives.</span></li> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Build products: Collaborate with Engineering and ecosystem players to build products that customers love. experienceProfile.rawText: <div class="content-intro"><p>Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.</p> <p>Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.</p> <p>From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech</p> <p>Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.</p> <p>Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.</p> <p>Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, Whats App, Airtel, CRED, Bookmy Show, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.</p> <p>We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India &amp; SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, Master Card, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), Bill Me (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.</p> <p>But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People &gt; Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy &amp; Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors,&nbsp; you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.</p></div><p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>The ROLE: </strong><strong>&nbsp;</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">As a Growth PM at Razorpay, you will play a pivotal role in driving the adoption, activation, retention, and monetization of our products. Work shoulder-to-shoulder with Growth business counterparts and DEPA (Design, Engineering, Product Analytics) partners.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>What we need:</strong></span></p> <ul> <li style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Data-native PM - you think in funnels, cohorts, and experiments before PRDs.
